# agentic-forms

Build forms and collect answers into tables.

Keywords: forms,surveys,responses,agents,mcp,cli,tables,collaboration.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-forms".
- CLI: agentic-forms summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-forms mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
